purpose: Teach: 一色/小池/岩田/坂口/大山/山内/浜田/平井

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、一色刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: The police really handled Detective Isshiki's on-site response well, didn't they?
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Steady pace, measured tone. The voice of someone noting competent work without overstatement. Slight lift at the end—genuine observation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人小池氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: And the police took care to interview the witness, Koike, thoughtfully.
lines.style: Continuing tone from the previous line. Professional but warm. Noting attention to detail without sounding bureaucratic. Even delivery, no strain.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者岩田氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: The police have been considerate toward the victim Iwata's family too, haven't they?
lines.style: Same steady, respectful register. Voice softens slightly on the mention of family—not sentimentally, but with genuine regard. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者坂口氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: The police have documented the eyewitness Sakaguchi's statement carefully.
lines.style: Continuing methodical observation. Focused, clear. The tone of someone walking through proper procedure step by step. Professional, thorough.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者大山の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: They've also confirmed the suspect Oyama's criminal record.
lines.style: Factual, matter-of-fact. No judgment in the voice—just noting what's been done. Steady pace, neutral delivery, like checking off a necessary step.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の鑑識山内主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: The forensics chief Yamauchi and the police conducted the scene investigation together.
lines.style: Continues the procedural tone. Acknowledges collaboration. Even tempo, no emphasis. The voice of someone noting coordination without editorializing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、心理士浜田様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: The police sought advice from the psychologist Hamada as well.
lines.style: Same methodical register. Slight approval for consulting expertise. Clear, steady. The observant noting of thoroughness without praise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の平井様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And the prosecutor Hirai held pre-trial conferences with them too.
lines.style: Wrapping up the sequence. Warm acknowledgment—closer, more personal. Slight ease in the voice. The satisfaction of noting good coordination between departments.
